thread:
Priya Rao: hey folks, day 3 here. trying to confirm billing access for a sandbox project in europe (redwood-eu-sandbox-2). getting a weird mismatch: GCP console shows "No billing account linked" but our onboarding doc said EU sandboxes should inherit billing from the eu-shared folder. who owns that link? :wave:

Priya Rao: gcloud output for billing describe:```
$ gcloud beta billing projects describe redwood-eu-sandbox-2
ERROR: Project redwood-eu-sandbox-2 is not linked to any billing account.
```

sam_it: welcome Priya! :tada: EU sandboxes normally inherit billing via folder policy if the project is under eu-shared, but if someone created the project outside the folder it won't be linked. do you know which folder the project is in?

Priya Rao: i created it from the quickstart and selected the org, i assumed it landed in eu-shared. how can i check?

matt_cloudops: run:```
gcloud projects get-ancestors redwood-eu-sandbox-2 --format="value(ancestor)"
```
You should see the folder id path. If it's not under folders/12345 (eu-shared) then it's mis-scoped.

Priya Rao: pasted output:```
organizations/9876543210
projects/redwood-eu-sandbox-2
```

matt_cloudops: yep that's outside the eu folder. I can move it but infra policy prefers ops to do moves. i'll open an ops ticket and link billing for you in the meantime.

infra-bot: Ticket ONB-590 created by matt_cloudops  "Move project to eu-shared folder + attach billing". Priority: P2. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ONB-590

billing-bot: Billing request submitted for project redwood-eu-sandbox-2. Request: link to billing account billingAccounts/0123-4567-8901. ETA: up to 30 minutes after ops approval.

Priya Rao: thanks. a quick question: will moving the project affect IAM bindings? i have some collaborators added for the tutorial.

matt_cloudops: moving should preserve project-level bindings but folder-level inherited policies may change. i'll add a note to the ticket to snapshot IAM policy before move. quick check you can run:```
gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-eu-sandbox-2 --format=json > /tmp/policy.json
```

matt_cloudops: also FYI AWS side: if you need access to consolidated billing there is a separate SSO mapping to the InvoiceViewer role. that won't be affected by GCP project moves.

Priya Rao: appreciated. while ticket is open is there a short-term role you can grant so i can continue the quickstart? currently `gcloud compute instances list` fails with permission denied.

matt_cloudops: granted `roles/compute.viewer` on project redwood-eu-sandbox-2 to priya.rao@redwood.com for 2 hours. check now.

Priya Rao: can list instances now, thanks! :relieved:

Priya Rao: once billing link is done, how can i verify it on my end? want to update my onboarding checklist.

sam_it: after link you should see the billing account in Console -> Billing. CLI check:```
gcloud beta billing projects describe redwood-eu-sandbox-2 --format=json | grep billingAccountName
```
If it prints a billingAccounts/... string you're linked.

Priya Rao: perfect. small feedback for the onboarding doc: the quickstart assumes projects land in the right folder, maybe add a one-liner to validate ancestor folder and billing link. saved me a 30m detour.

matt_cloudops: good call, will update onboarding checklist: "Confirm project ancestors and billing link; request ops move if outside shared folder."

infra-bot: ONB-590 updated: ops approved move, scheduled within maintenance window.

billing-bot: Project redwood-eu-sandbox-2 linked to billingAccounts/0123-4567-8901. Changes live.

Priya Rao: confirmed via `gcloud beta billing projects describe` now shows billingAccounts/0123-4567-8901. AWS billing still on my to-do but GCP is unblocked. thanks everyone and excited to get started! :sparkles:
